headline: At least 5 killed, over two dozen injured as bus plunges into drain in Punjab's Hafizabad
description: <p>LAHORE: At least five people were killed and 27 others injured when a passenger bus plunged into a drain in Punjab’s Hafizabad district on Thursday, according to Rescue 1122.</p> <p>Rescue services said the mishap occurred in the Fatehke area of Pindi Bhattian tehsil. headline: Death toll from Thar ambulance fire rises to nine: district official
description: <p>HYDERABAD: The death toll from an ambulance fire in Sindh’s Tharparkar rose to nine on Thursday, according to Mithi Deputy Commissioner Hameed Jagirani.</p> <p>The incident occurred on Wednesday night when an oxygen cylinder exploded in an ambulance at a Peoples Primary Healthcare Initiative (PPHI)-run hospital in the Dano Dhandhal area of Nagarparkar taluka.</p> <p>Jagirani said the blast occurred in an oxygen cylinder while it was being managed for a female patient in the ambulance.</p> <p>The woman had given birth to a baby boy at a basic health

headline: Lahore ranks world’s most polluted major city as Punjab battles poor air quality
description: <p>LAHORE: Lahore was ranked the world’s most polluted major city on Thursday, with an Air Quality Index (AQI) of 419, as air pollution levels remained high across Punjab ahead of the peak <a href="https://www.dawn.com/news/1950531">smog season</a>.</p> <p>According to IQAir’s live global ranking for 10am to 11am on Oct 29, Lahore topped the list, followed by Cairo with an AQI of 274 and Delhi with 220. headline: 45 Nust researchers ranked among top 2pc of global scientists
description: <p>ISLAMABAD: As many as 45 researchers from the National University of Sciences and Technology (Nust) have earned the prestigious honour of being among the world’s top 2pc of scientists in 2026, say rankings compiled by Stanford University and Elsevier.</p> <p>According to a press release issued by Nust, the distinction places Nust researchers among an international community of leading scholars whose work is contributing immensely to the advancement of knowledge and scientific progress across diverse disciplines.</p> <p>Notably, 16 Nust researchers have consiste

headline: Karachi man guns down two sisters for ‘using TikTok’
description: <p>KARACHI: Two young sisters were allegedly shot dead by their brother over their use of social media in Drigh Road, within the jurisdiction of Shah Faisal Colony police, on Wednesday, police said.</p> <p>Korangi SSP Fida Husain Janwari told <em>Dawn</em> that Sobia, 25, and Hira, 20, were gunned down inside their home in New Rehmanabad by their brother, Rehan.</p> <p>The senior officer said the initial investigation suggested that the suspect had warned his sisters against using TikTok, which appeared to be a possible motive behind the double murder.

headline: Commodity prices to surge 23pc, warns World Bank
description: <p>WASHINGTON: Global commodity prices are set to surge 23 per cent in 2026, the World Bank said on Wednesday, citing rising energy prices and disruptions to cargo shipping during the Middle East war, grain shipment problems in the Black Sea and high demand for safe-haven assets such as gold.</p> <p>Oil, natural gas, food and metals prices all rose sharply this year as global shocks mounted, the World Bank said in its latest Commodity Markets Outlook. headline: Forest loss, wildfires in Indonesia put orangutans at high extinction risk
description: <p>Orangutan populations are at a higher risk of extinction amid soaring forest loss and raging wildfires across key habitats in Sumatra and Kalimantan, as the world struggles to keep up with the global target of halting biodiversity loss by 2030.</p> <p>In a joint report published on Oct 24, environmental groups Mighty Earth and Satya Bumi issued a “red code” warning for the Tapanuli orangutan, often considered world’s rarest great ape, which is facing a higher extinction risk.</p> <p>The species is endemic to the fragmented forests of the Batang Toru ecosystem i

headline: Bangladesh presses India before Ganges water treaty expires
description: <p>With a 30-year Ganges water-sharing treaty with India expiring in December, Bangladesh fears failure to strike a new deal could deepen water shortages, threatening tens of millions of livelihoods.</p> <p>In Bangladesh’s parched Barind region, 72-year-old Bikash Soren remembers when the Ganges river flowing in from neighbouring India carried large boats past his village year-round.</p> <p>“For almost three months a year, you hardly see the river flowing,” the Protestant priest said.</p> <p>Two farmers died by suicide last season, he added, after dwin

headline: Pakistan terms Afghan claims regarding Angoor Adda incident 'fabrication of lies'
description: <p>The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting on Wednesday dismissed a statement by Afghanistan’s defence ministry regarding the firing at Angoor Adda border area, terming it a “fabrication of lies”.</p> <p>Afghan security forces opened <a href="https://www.dawn.com/news/2040360">unprovoked fire</a> on Pakistan Army border posts and residential areas in the border area in Lower South Waziristan on Tuesday. The attack, which violated border protocols, claimed the life of one local and injured five, while provoking a swift response from security forces.</p>
